rationale: Reuse the exact divider created within the same model11 face batch instead of allocating two overlapping carriers for a classic Split. No old carrier coalescing or coordinate tolerance is added. Native HA E2E before the next beta is tracked in houseplan-e2e#26.

summary.ru: После разделения комнаты общая стена имеет один ID и одну толщину у обеих частей.
summary.en: A split room shares one divider identity and thickness between its two parts.
